name: Dranik Catacombs
summary: Ancient subterranean tunnels beneath Dranik, corrupted by Discord and haunted by Muramite experiments.
description: The Dranik Catacombs are a vast network of subterranean tunnels carved beneath the ruined lands of Dranik. Once sacred burial chambers for the Dragorn, the catacombs were seized and corrupted by Muramite forces. Discord energy permeates the halls, animating the dead, warping the living, and destabilizing the ancient stonework. Muramite inquisitors, arcane specialists, and experimental warbeasts patrol the deeper chambers. Resistance agents attempt infiltration, but few return from the depths.
